Update13 February 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Patch Notes — February 13, 2026
Major Serpentis update: faster routes to Sirothe, four tiers of Sapphire relic weapons (new Warclub type, T1 drops with Sirothe Ingot crafts), armor ilevel 53 and pick-your-piece crates, and imaging moved to craftable image items instead of direct weapon imaging.

📜 Patch Notes — February 13, 2026

Behold the Power of Serpentis

Lerman's Studies of the dark passage ways of the Serpentis' halls has finally proved fruitful after countless adventures have braved their depths. New passage ways and improvements upon its relics have been discovered.

Passage Ways

  • The winding pathways have been mapped thoroughly and now a direct path has been mapped directly to Sirothe's chambers. Players will now be able to streamline the dungeon directly from the Two Keepers > Duaxini > Dimensial Crevice Summon of Lerman/Fangbow/Carmilla and then Sirothe's final room. ## Sapphire Relics
  • The relics of Serpentis have been upgraded, broken down into 4 tiers, with the final version being a Sapphire imbued item with upgraded effects. These items have all had their iLvl's buffed slightly per tier, with the T4 being equivalen to T6 Obsidian
  • T1 weapons will drop from Sirothe now, and can be crafted up to T4 with typical dungeon materials and the new Serpentis unique material, Sirothe's Ingot, which will drop from Sirothe only.
  • Sapphire Infused Weapons at T4 will now feature the following improvements/effects added

Shortspear

Sapphire Fangbane

  • Magic Attack Coefficient Added

Daggers

Sapphire Dark Watcher's Dagger

  • Effect will now increase up to 25% Melee Critical Rate over time

Sapphire Void Dagger

  • Attack Speed Reduction increased to 150 and Move Speed Reduction increased to 15% on Target

Axe

Sapphire Dancing Queen

  • Melee critical Bonus Increased to 12%

Greataxes

Sapphire Skull Spliter

  • Chance to proc a guaranteed Critical Hit with a bonus 30% Critical Damage

Sapphire Veiled Terror

  • Skill Bonus Damage increased to 10%

Staff

Sapphire Pristine Wit

  • Effect duration increased to 12 seconds

Greatclub

Sapphire Demon's Heart

  • Effect duration increased to 12 seconds

Bow

Sapphire Soulripper

  • Proc chance increased

Shield

Sapphire Blooddrinker Blossom

  • Effect Duration Increased to 12 seconds

Club

A new one handed club has been added. Demon's Charm (T1) ----- Sapphire Demon's Charm (T4)

  • T2/T3 Effect - Reduces all Mana Costs by 20% for 5 Seconds
  • T4 - Reduces all Mana Costs by 40% for 12 Seconds ## The Warclub

A New weapon type will be introduced - The Warclub. These are 2Handed Greatclubs, with no healing co-efficient and full melee DPS co-efficients. Its weapon damage type bonus is Blunt. (Bonus damage to Plate) Its weapon passive proc is a guaranteed parry.

Warclub

Sirothe's Hatred (ilvl 62 aka Ayanad)

  • Full Strength
  • Chance to stun target and all enemies in a 5 meter radius for 2 seconds
  • There is a small chance that Sirothe will Drop this weapon instead of a Sirothe Ingot ## Armor / Equipment

All armor drops from Serpentis have been improved to iLvL 53 (the same tier as Anthalon) making their use a bit more plausable. Crates have been added to Sirothe's Loot Drop Table that can be opened to select one armor piece of your choice. (No more praying for sleeve drops)

Crafting

All weapons will drop from Sirothe at T1 (Fangbane is Considered T3) and will require typical dungeon mats to craft up with the inclusion of a Sirothe Ingot and Sapphires. Sirothe Ingots will drop 1 (ONE) per Sirothe kill. They are tradable. Weapons can be crafted at the Northern Serpentis Dimensional Distorted Workbench.

== 📜 Patch Notes — February 13, 2026 ==

== Behold the Power of Serpentis ==

== Lerman's Studies of the dark passage ways of the Serpentis' halls has finally proved fruitful after countless adventures have braved their depths. New passage ways and improvements upon its relics have been discovered. ==

== Passage Ways ==

* The winding pathways have been mapped thoroughly and now a direct path has been mapped directly to Sirothe's chambers. Players will now be able to streamline the dungeon directly from the Two Keepers > Duaxini > Dimensial Crevice Summon of Lerman/Fangbow/Carmilla and then Sirothe's final room. ## Sapphire Relics
* The relics of Serpentis have been upgraded, broken down into 4 tiers, with the final version being a Sapphire imbued item with upgraded effects. These items have all had their iLvl's buffed slightly per tier, with the T4 being equivalen to T6 Obsidian
* T1 weapons will drop from Sirothe now, and can be crafted up to T4 with typical dungeon materials and the new Serpentis unique material, Sirothe's Ingot, which will drop from Sirothe only.
* Sapphire Infused Weapons at T4 will now feature the following improvements/effects added

=== Shortspear ===

Sapphire Fangbane

* Magic Attack Coefficient Added

=== Daggers ===

Sapphire Dark Watcher's Dagger

* Effect will now increase up to 25% Melee Critical Rate over time

Sapphire Void Dagger

* Attack Speed Reduction increased to 150 and Move Speed Reduction increased to 15% on Target

=== Axe ===

Sapphire Dancing Queen

* Melee critical Bonus Increased to 12%

=== Greataxes ===

Sapphire Skull Spliter

* Chance to proc a guaranteed Critical Hit with a bonus 30% Critical Damage

Sapphire Veiled Terror

* Skill Bonus Damage increased to 10%

=== Staff ===

Sapphire Pristine Wit

* Effect duration increased to 12 seconds

=== Greatclub ===

Sapphire Demon's Heart

* Effect duration increased to 12 seconds

=== Bow ===

Sapphire Soulripper

* Proc chance increased

=== Shield ===

Sapphire Blooddrinker Blossom

* Effect Duration Increased to 12 seconds

=== Club ===

A new one handed club has been added.
Demon's Charm (T1) ----- Sapphire Demon's Charm (T4)

* T2/T3 Effect - Reduces all Mana Costs by 20% for 5 Seconds
* T4 - Reduces all Mana Costs by 40% for 12 Seconds ## The Warclub

A New weapon type will be introduced - The Warclub.
These are 2Handed Greatclubs, with no healing co-efficient and full melee DPS co-efficients.
Its weapon damage type bonus is Blunt. (Bonus damage to Plate)
Its weapon passive proc is a guaranteed parry.

=== Warclub ===

Sirothe's Hatred (ilvl 62 aka Ayanad)

* Full Strength
* Chance to stun target and all enemies in a 5 meter radius for 2 seconds
* There is a small chance that Sirothe will Drop this weapon instead of a Sirothe Ingot ## Armor / Equipment

All armor drops from Serpentis have been improved to iLvL 53 (the same tier as Anthalon) making their use a bit more plausable.
Crates have been added to Sirothe's Loot Drop Table that can be opened to select one armor piece of your choice. (No more praying for sleeve drops)

== Crafting ==

All weapons will drop from Sirothe at T1 (Fangbane is Considered T3) and will require typical dungeon mats to craft up with the inclusion of a Sirothe Ingot and Sapphires.
Sirothe Ingots will drop 1 (ONE) per Sirothe kill. They are tradable.
Weapons can be crafted at the Northern Serpentis Dimensional Distorted Workbench.
